periods.time: vol-04 ch-001, one ordinary school day from early morning through afternoon

name.zh: 加加美的秘密跟踪采访：史黛菈篇

periods.location: Hagun Academy dorms, running route, classrooms, cafeteria and training grounds
periods.summary: Kagami secretly follows Stella through a normal day and records Stella's training discipline, school life, appetite and private affection for Ikki.
periods.cause: Kagami seeks material for a journalist-style profile of the famous Crimson Princess.
periods.process: Kagami wakes before dawn to tail Stella, but Stella and Ikki's running pace overwhelms her. After recovering from fatigue and dehydration with an IV drip, Kagami continues observing classes, lunch and afternoon training. She notes Stella's Japanese fluency, occasional cultural misunderstanding, enormous appetite and health-check data. In the afternoon, Kagami sees Stella smell Ikki's discarded shirt with a blissful expression while Ikki is away.
periods.outcome: The profile frames Stella not only as an A-rank magical prodigy but as a diligent athlete and lovestruck partner. Kagami obtains an embarrassing photo but decides not to publish it because of Stella's position, joking that it could be used as leverage.
periods.aftermath: Stella's private romantic side and routine with Ikki become curated evidence for daily-life characterization rather than a public scandal.
periods.significance: Adds concrete daily-routine details for Stella: early rising, physical training despite magical talent, ordinary class participation, huge appetite and secret attachment to Ikki.
